errors.storageFull: Local storage is full. Please export and delete photos.

errorView.title: This view could not be displayed
errorView.text: A record probably has an unexpected format. Your data has not been changed. You can reload the view or switch to another area.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This area does not exist (any more) – the entry may have been deleted.

storage.title: Local storage unavailable
storage.text: TERPGRID needs IndexedDB in this browser (in server mode as a working copy for offline use and synchronisation). This is not possible in private mode or when site storage is blocked. The THC Lab still works.

localMode.title: Local mode
localMode.noAccount: This installation runs without a server. Data stays in this browser only – there is no account.

serverOnly.title: Requires your own server
serverOnly.text: Shared spaces and friends require a TERPGRID server and an account. In local mode, all data stays on this device.

offline.title: Offline
offline.collabText: Friends and shared spaces need a connection to the server. You can keep using your private data offline.

exp.head: Section;Label;Value
exp.disclaimer: All values are calculated estimates and not dosing advice.
exp.local: Calculated locally in the browser – no data was transmitted.

db.noIdb: IndexedDB is not available in this browser (e.g. private mode).
db.removed: The local working copy has been removed.
db.openFail: The database could not be opened.
db.otherTab: The database is in use in another tab. Please close other TERPGRID tabs.
db.notFound: Record not found – it may already have been deleted.

srv.unreachable: Server unreachable – changes remain stored on this device.
